description.narrative: IFC will provide a senior secured loan of up to US$33 million equivalent (the IFC Loan) to subsidiaries of Eurasia Group AG (EG AG, the Group), a Swiss-based group that distributes and services John Deere and other Western-made agricultural machinery in Kazakhstan and the Kyrgyz Republic. The IFC Loan will finance the construction of new service centers in Astana, Almaty, and Pavlodar in Kazakhstan, and in Bishkek in the Kyrgyz Republic (the Project). The IFC Loan will be committed as follows: (i) up to US$30 million equivalent to Eurasia Group Kazakhstan LLC (EG KZ), and (ii) up to US$3 million equivalent to Eurasia Group Kyrgyzstan LLC (EG KZ, together with EG KZ, the Companies).

The expected Project-level outcomes include increased access to advanced agricultural equipment for farmers, economy-wide benefits through job creation, and stimulation of downstream linkages along the distribution and service chains. The Project is also expected to enhance competitiveness and efficiency in the agricultural machinery and services market in Kazakhstan and the Kyrgyz Republic through demonstration and replication effects.
